'''Stellar control stations''' were the part of the [[Star Chamber (Star Temple)|Star Chambers]] that controlled the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa's]] [[Infinity Gate]]s. The stellar control station on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] was buried deep below the [[Prime Gate]].
